semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Okaya & Co. India Pvt Ltd acts as a distributor and logistics support provider for various semiconductor-related products, but does not manufacture semiconductor components directly.
summary: Okaya & Co. India Pvt Ltd facilitates the trading, import/export, and logistics of semiconductor-related materials and equipment in India. They represent several partner companies that provide high-purity components and materials essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
capabilities: Distribution of high-purity fluid handling components
Logistics support for semiconductor manufacturing materials

regional_presence.India: Okaya India operates as a distributor and logistics provider for semiconductor materials and equipment within the Indian market.
